title: Pocketwire Rewards Consecutive Achiever Milestone Schedule
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members who already received quarterly milestone bonuses within the last twelve months have their next milestone bonus set by their milestone streak.

## Rule

With a milestone streak of at least 3, the milestone bonus is computed on spend, as the milestone spend measure multiplied by 1.5 points per USD rounded down to whole points, in place of the milestone tier amount; with a milestone streak of at least 1 but below 3, it is the milestone tier amount plus the milestone spend measure above the milestone threshold of the tier held on the credit date multiplied by 0.5 points per USD, the added part rounded down to whole points and never below zero. With no milestone bonus entry in that period, no such adjustment applies.

## Definitions

- The milestone streak is the number of quarterly milestone bonus entries already dated within the last twelve months.
- The milestone spend measure is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last three months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same three months.
- The milestone tier amount is the milestone bonus points of the tier held on the credit date.
- Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.
- A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date. A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Milestone threshold of each tier

| Tier held on the credit date | Milestone threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 1000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 2000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 3500.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 5000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 8000.00 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 15000.00 |

## Streak bands

| Milestone streak | Milestone bonus |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the spend measure multiplied by 1.5, rounded down, in place of the milestone tier amount |
| 1 or 2 | the milestone tier amount plus the spend measure above the tier's milestone threshold multiplied by 0.5, the added part rounded down and never below zero |
| 0 | no such adjustment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical ledgers)

- Streak 3, spend measure 9876.54 USD: 9876.54 multiplied by 1.5 is 14814.81, rounded down to 14814 points.
- Streak 2, Gold held on the credit date, spend measure 4321.00 USD, milestone tier amount 2000 points: the spend above 3500.00 USD is 821.00; multiplied by 0.5 it is 410.5, rounded down to 410. The bonus is 2000 plus 410, which is 2410 points.
- Streak 1, Gold held on the credit date, spend measure 3000.00 USD: the spend is below the threshold, so the added part is 0 and the bonus is the milestone tier amount.
